out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food, Reminder
violations.observation: OBSERVED INCOMPLETE REMINDER STATEMENT ON CUSTOMER FACING MENU, NO REMINDER STATEMENT OBSERVED ON TAKE OUT MENU for SALMON ROLL, TUNA ROLL.
violations.corrective_action: The Consumer Advisory shall include a reminder statement that includes asterisking (*) the animal-derived foods requiring disclosure to a footnote that states one of the following: 1) 'Regarding the safety of these items, written information is available upon request', or 2) 'Consuming raw or undercooked meats, seafood, shellfish, or eggs may increase your risk of foodborne illness', or 3) 'Consuming raw or undercooked meats, seafood, shellfish, or eggs may increase your risk of foodborne illness, especially if you have certain medical conditions'. EHS ASSISTED CFM IN CREATING TABLE CARD WITH COMPLETE REMINDER STATEMENT TO BE PLACED AT FRONT NEAR REGISTER/CUSTOMER FACING MENU. CFM WILL INFORM CORPORATE TO UPDATE TAKEOUT MENU.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: OBSERVED RAW SALMON AND RAW TUNA ON SHELF ABOVE AVOCADOS AND IMITATION CRAB IN 2 DR PREP..
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. CFM MOVED RAW SALMON AND RAW TUNA TO BOTTOM OF UNIT. EHS REVIEWED PROPER STORAGE ORDER OF FOODS IN EQUIPMENT WITH CFM.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Common Name, Working Containers
violations.observation: Working containers of poisonous and toxic materials are not properly labeled with a common name. SPRAY BOTTLE WITH PURPLE COLORED LIQUID FOUND NEXT TO FRONT HAND SINK.
violations.corrective_action: Label all working containers of poisonous and toxic materials, including cleaners and sanitizers, with a common name to prevent the dangerous misuse of these materials. CFM LABELLED SPRAY BOTTLE WITH CHEMICAL NAME.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. OBSERVED LARGE BUCKETS OF SAUCES AND GINGER STORED ON FLOOR.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. CFM WILL WORK TO MOVE ALL FOODS ONTO STORAGE SHELVES.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items, Stored off Floor, Clean Location
violations.observation: OBSERVED BOXES OF SINGLE-SERVICE UTENSILS AND LINENS ON FLOOR.
violations.corrective_action: Store clean equipment, utensils, and linens in a clean, dry location where they are not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination and at least 6 inches above the floor. CFM WILL WORK TO MOVE ALL BOXES OF UTENSILS AND LINENS ONTO SHELVES.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Food-Contact Surfaces, Corrosion-Resistant/Nonabsorbent Materials
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment and/or utensils are not durable: CARDBOARD LINING SHELVES IN BACK KITCHEN AREA.
violations.corrective_action: Materials that are used in the construction of utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment may not allow the migration of deleterious substances or impart colors, odors, or tastes to food and under normal use conditions shall be durable, corrosion-resistant, and nonabsorbent. DISCONTINUE USING CARDBOARD TO LINE SHELVES.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Accumulation of food debris and splash on floors, walls, and ceilings throughout kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. Clean ceiling ventilation ducts and ceilings tiles surround ducts (especially near front cookline). Clean underneath equipment, shelving and storage containers. Clean outside surfaces and doors of equipment (refrigerators, ice machine).

out_items.name: Adequate ventilation and lighting, designated areas used

violations.title: Protective Shielding on Light Bulbs
violations.observation: OBSERVED CEILING LIGHT ABOVE SUSHI AREA WITHOUT A COVER.
violations.corrective_action: Replace ceiling light cover. QUICKWAY HIBACHI GRILL (Inspection Date: 04/22/2026) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Adequate ventilation and lighting, designated areas used

violations.title: Ventilation System Cleaning
violations.observation: Intake and exhaust air ducts are not being cleaned at a frequency necessary to prevent contamination by dust, dirt, and other materials. Observed accumulation of dust and debris at ceiling air ducts in back kitchen prep area and above sushi prep area.
violations.corrective_action: Clean intake and exhaust air ducts at regularly intervals to prevent them from becoming sources of contamination.

violations.title: Protective Shielding on Light Bulbs
violations.observation: Observed ceiling light cover cracked at light fixture above main prep area.
violations.corrective_action: Provide end caps to completely enclose the light bulb or purchase and install new ceiling light cover.

out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: Permit to Operate Posted in Conspicuous Location
violations.observation: The establishment has not posted the permit to operate in a conspicuous location. Observed 2024 food establishment permit posted.
violations.corrective_action: A valid permit shall be posted in every food establishment in a conspicuous place in the public view. Food establishment permits are issued for a calendar year and expire on December 31 regardless of the month of issue. Contact the HD at 703-246-2201 or email [county email] to obtain a copy of your 2025 food establishment permit. CFM will check with mall office for facility’s mail.

violations.title: Where to Wash
violations.observation: A food employee was observed cleaning their hands in a food preparation sink, warewashing sink or in a mop sink. Observed employee washing hands in the 3 compartment sink.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands in ONLY a designated handsink. EHS reminded employee that handwashing should only occur in handwashing sink. EHS recommended that CFM retrain employees on proper handwashing technique to include where and when to wash.

out_items.name: Proper cooling methods used; adequate equipment for temperature control

violations.title: Methods to Facilitate Proper Cooling
violations.observation: The following methods used for cooling were not adequate to facilitate proper cooling: observed large container filled to top with cooked noodles with lid on in #1, observed large portions of noodles and shrimp in #5.
violations.corrective_action: Cooling hot foods shall be accomplished as follows: 1) placing the food in shallow pans; 2) separating the food into smaller or thinner portions; 3) using rapid cooling equipment; 4) stirring the food in a container placed in an ice water bath; 5) using containers that facilitate heat transfer; 6) adding ice as an ingredient; or other effective methods. Food containers placed in cooling and cold equipment to cool shall be: 1) arranged in the equipment to provide maximum heat transfer through the containers walls, and 2) loosely covered or uncovered as long as protected from contamination to facilitate heat transfer from the surface of the food. EHS explained proper cooling methods to CFM. CFM agreed to store foods in smaller portions and will ensure lids are left open to facilitate faster cooling of cooked foods.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Cutting Board, When to Resurface or Discard
violations.observation: The cutting board in the back kitchen was observed to be heavily scratched and scored. The food contact surface is no longer easily cleaned and sanitized due to condition.
violations.corrective_action: Surfaces such as cutting blocks and boards that are subject to scratching and scoring shall be resurfaced if they can no longer be effectively cleaned and sanitized, or discarded if they are not capable of being resurfaced. CFM will purchase new cutting boards.

violations.title: When to Wash
violations.observation: A food employee failed to wash his or her hands before engaging in food preparation, after touching bare human body parts, after coughing, sneezing, eating, after handling soiled utensils, or after engaging in any activity that could contaminate the hands. - OBSERVED EMPLOYEE ASSIST LEAVE KITCHEN TO ASSIST WITH PRODUCT DELIVERY AND RETURN TO KITCHEN WITHOUT WASHING HANDS.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands OFTEN especially after handling trash, using the restroom, handling raw meats, handling soiled equipment and utensils, BEFORE putting on clean gloves, etc. Proper handwashing frequencies will aid in the reduction of foodborne illness. - EHS EDUCATED CFM ON VARIOUS SCENARIOS REQUIRING HAND WASHING. CFM WILL DISCUSS WITH ALL STAFF WHEN TO WASH HANDS.

violations.title: Proper thawing methods used for TCS Foods
violations.observation: Observed the following food thawing using an improper method: OBSERVED SHRIMP THAWING IN ROOM TEMPERATURE WATER NEXT TO 3 COMPARTMENT SINK.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be thawed using one of the following methods: 1) under refrigeration that maintains the food temperature at 41F or less, 2) completely submerged under running water at a water temperature of 70F or below with a sufficient velocity to agitate and float off loose particles of food as long as held for period of time at a temperature of 41F or less, or 3) as part of a cooking process if the food is cooked as specified by Law or thawed in a microwave oven and immediately transferred to a conventional cooking process. - EHS EDUCATED CFM ON PROPER THAWING PROCEDURES. CFM WILL DISCUSS WITH STAFF TO THAW FROZEN FOODS UNDER RUNNING WATER.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wipings Clothes Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter. OBSERVED WET WIPING CLOTHS ON FLAT TOP AND 1 DR PREP UNIT.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. - EHS INSTRUCTED CFM TO STORE WET WIPING CLOTHS IN SANITIZER SOLUTION. QUICKWAY HIBACHI GRILL (Inspection Date: 11/08/2024) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: OBSERVED PLUMBING CONNECTIONS UNDER HAND SINK NEAR REGISTER LEAKING.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. CFM TO REPAIR LEAKING PIPE. PROVIDE PROOF OF REPAIR TO EHS.
